external_collaboration.evidence_quote: As part of its Graduate Medical Education (GME) program, McLaren maintains academic affiliations with medical schools at Wayne State University, Michigan State University and Central Medical University. McLaren’s seven (7) GME campuses offer 37 residencies and 12 fellowship programs that train over 650 future physicians annually. All McLaren GME programs are accredited, and they are overseen and managed centrally by the Department of Academic Affairs.
